title: SkailrExpertConfig
description: Project configuration at .claude/experts/config.json. Authoritative machine sidecar for contract expert-config-and-naming v1. Logical schema id: skailr.expert-config/v1.
$comment: A MISSING config.json means all defaults and is the normal state of a project that has never minted. Never treat absence as an error. Consumers should read the default values below from this schema rather than hardcoding them.

schema.description: Schema tag. Required so an unversioned config blob is caught rather than silently reinterpreted by a future reader.

gate_mode.description: soft: an expert fail becomes a recorded finding plus a heads-up and never halts. hard: a fail halts the orchestrator in the /map-repo-confirm-gate shape. Soft is the shipped default; hard is not exercised in v1.
gate_mode.$comment: An out-of-enum gate_mode is a validation error, not a silent fallback. Getting gate behavior wrong by typo is exactly the quiet failure that makes a gate decorative.

auto_mint.description: When false, only explicit /mint-expert may mint. The /map-repo (T2) and build-consult (T3) triggers become no-ops.

roster_cap.description: Soft cap on roster size. Exceeding it does not block a mint; it posts a heads-up recommending consolidation.
roster_cap.$comment: Exceeding the cap is a check-experts warning at exit 0, and an error at exit 1 only under --strict. The cap is soft by design and must not break an ordinary run.

mint_threshold.description: Independent signals required for the same vertical before an auto-mint fires. A config value, not a constant, because the number is an unvalidated guess (brief risk 4).
